page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew glossary entries, set side by side under the running heads. Left column first, then right column. Catchword "No." at the lower right; signature "Mmm" at the lower left. Page number at the top right.

main_text.l: תְּרוּמָה separata pers, No. f. f. Rad. רוּם.
תְּרוֹמַמְנָה[?] exaltentur, fut. Pual, 3. pl. f. Rad. רוֹם.
תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי exaltasti, vel vit, me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. רוּם.
תְּרֹנָּה cantabit, Prov. 1. 20. pro תָּרוֹן, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. parag. Rad. רָנַן.
תְּרוּעָה clangor, No. f. f. Rad. רוּעַ clangere.
לִתְרוּפָה sanationi, No. f. f. præf. R. רוּף quassare.
תָּרוּץ curres, vel ret, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. רוּץ.
תְּרוּץ[?] quassaris, Ezech. 29. 7. pro תֵּרָץ, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. Rad. רָצַץ[?].
תִּרְזָה[?] cupressus, No. f. f. Rad. רָזָה emaciavit.
תְּרַחֵם misereberis, vel tur, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. רָחַם.
תְּרַצַּשְׁנָה[?] allident, fut. Piel, 3. pl. f. R. רָצַשׁ.
תְּרִיבוּ contendetis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. רוֹב.
תָּרִיד[?] planxeris, vel rit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. (vel 3. f. f. Rad. רוּד dominatus est).
הַתָּרִים exploratores, Ben. Kal, pl. m. R. תּוּר exploravit.
הָרִימוּ attolletis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. רוּם.
תָּרִיעוּ clangetis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. רוּעַ.
תָּרִין[?] celeriter extendis, vel dit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. רוּץ.
וְתוֹרְךָ[?] docebit te, fut. Hiph. 3. f. fæm. aff. Rad. יָרָה.
תָּרוּם exaltaberis, vel tur, וְתָרוּם elevata fuit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. רָמַם, vel רוּם.
תַּרְמִיתָם dolus eorum, No.

page.notes: Several Hebrew forms are uncertain at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The page number at the top right is hard to read and is marked [?]. The signature "Mmm" and catchword "No." are at the foot. The entries are a glossary list, so each entry is one line.
